title: Shell-wise push-forward and homotopy: telescoping identities (S1), (S2)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let push_k(F, X) ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), homot_k(F, G, X) ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(ℝ^P) (k ∈ ℕ, F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P, X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P), domain univ) be operations satisfying the following four clauses of the frozen dor_lmb_fcd_pushforward_homotopy (PF), for all k, Λ ∈ ℝ≥0, Λ-Lipschitz F, G, F', G', compact E and IM X, Y vanishing off E: PF(1) push_k(id, X) = X; PF(2) push_k(F, X − Y) = push_k(F, X) − push_k(F, Y) and homot_k(F, G, X − Y) = homot_k(F, G, X) − homot_k(F, G, Y); PF(3) if F = F' and G = G' on E then push_k(F, X) = push_k(F', X) and homot_k(F, G, X) = homot_k(F', G', X); PF(5) if X ∈ 𝒟_{k+1} is IM, vanishes off E and ∂X is IM, then ∂push_{k+1}(F, X) = push_k(F, ∂X) and push_{k+1}(G, X) − push_{k+1}(F, X) − homot_k(F, G, ∂X) = ∂homot_{k+1}(F, G, X). Let E_j ⊆ ℝ^P (j ∈ ℕ) be compact with E_j ⊆ E_{j+1}; φ_j : ℝ^P → ℝ^P Λ_j-Lipschitz with 1 ≤ Λ_j ≤ Λ_{j+1} and φ_{j+1} = φ_j on E_j; W_j ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P), D_j, Z_j ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) integer multiplicity and vanishing off E_j, with ∂W_0(ω) = D_0(ω) − Z_0(ω) and ∂W_{j+1}(ω) = D_{j+1}(ω) + Z_j(ω) − Z_{j+1}(ω) for all j and ω. Then, with id = (x ↦ x), for every N: (S1) Σ_{j≤N} push_{m+1}(φ_j, W_j)(ω) − Σ_{j≤N} W_j(ω) − Σ_{j≤N} ∂homot_{m+1}(id, φ_j, W_j)(ω) = Σ_{j≤N} homot_m(id, φ_j, D_j)(ω) − homot_m(id, φ_N, Z_N)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^{m+1}(ℝ^P); (S2) Σ_{j≤N} ∂push_{m+1}(φ_j, W_j)(ω) = Σ_{j≤N} push_m(φ_j, D_j)(ω) − push_m(φ_N, Z_N)(ω) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^m(ℝ^P).
